sentences.text: Welcome to LumenDesk. This short lesson explains how to prepare a clear project brief.
sentences.speaker: speaker-01

sentences.text: First, describe the result you need. Then list the files, the deadline, and the people who will review the work.
sentences.speaker: speaker-01

sentences.text: Keep product names unchanged. Ask one clear question when a detail is missing.
sentences.speaker: speaker-01

sentences.text: Review the finished files before publishing. A useful report explains what was tested and what still needs confirmation.
sentences.speaker: speaker-01
